data.narrative:
Icarus is a seed-stage company in Defense & Security founded by Henry Kwan. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private companies and 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) operating in the same sector at seed and adjacent stages.

The peer-median method applied to four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This single method forms the basis for triangulation given data availability at the seed stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, with a central estimate of $700M. Key uncertainties include limited comparability across stage progression—the peer set includes primarily Series A companies alongside one seed-stage reference point (UFORCE)—and execution risk inherent to seed-stage ventures in a capital-intensive, regulated sector. The wide peer range ($125M–$4.0B) reflects heterogeneity in technology focus and market positioning within Defense & Security. Additional methodologies such as revenue multiple or DCF analysis cannot be applied without operational and financial data. The valuation reflects market multiples but should be stress-tested against competitive positioning, technical differentiation, and customer traction as deal documentation progresses.
